ch.s: Verses 1–6: “These are the words of the book which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maaseas, the son of Sedekias, the son of Asadias, the son of…”; Verses 7–12: “and they sent it to Jerusalem to Joakim the high priest, the son of Helkias, the son of Salom, and to the priests and to all the people…”; Verses 13–18: “Pray for us also to the Lord our God, for we have sinned against the Lord our God. To this day the wrath of the Lord and his…”; Verses 19–22: “Since the day that the Lord brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt to this present day, we have been disobedient to the Lord our God…”. People named: Baruch, Joakim, Sud, Sivan, Moses. Places: Babylon, Jerusalem, Judah, Egypt.
q: Read verses 1–6. What is happening, and what stands out to you most?
In verses 7–12, what do you learn about family and generations?
Read verse 1 slowly. What does it say about God, about people, and about how to live?
What does Baruch’s part in this chapter teach you — as an example to follow or a warning to heed?
Where do you see the theme of leadership and kingship in this chapter, and how does it connect to the rest of Baruch?
What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?
ch.a: Ask God to search your heart, confess what He shows you, and make any right amends.

ch.s: Verses 1–9: “O Lord Almighty, you God of Israel, the soul in anguish and the troubled spirit cries to you.”; Verses 10–18: “How is it, O Israel, that you are in your enemies’ land, that you have become old in a strange country, that you are defiled with the dead”; Verses 19–27: “they have vanished and gone down to Hades, and others have come up in their place.”; Verses 28–36: “so they perished, because they had no wisdom. They perished through their own foolishness.”; Verse 37: “Afterward she appeared upon earth, and lived with men.”. People named: Teman, Agar, Jacob. Places: Hades, Canaan, No.

ch.a: Before a decision this week, pause and ask what this chapter would counsel.

Go your way, for I am left desolate.”; Verses 28–36: “For as it was your decision to go astray from God, return and seek him ten times more.”; Verse 37: “Behold, your sons come, whom you sent away.
